sourceDesc.bibl: Métraux, Alfred (1939): Myths and Tales of the Matako Indians (The Gran Chaco, Argentinia). In: Ethnological Studies/Etnologiska Studier 9, 1-127. Quot. pp. 61-62.

projectDesc.p: Text digitized and encoded for use in the Forager Folklore Database.

body.p:
Once upon a time the palometa fish (nixwúk)Palometa (Serrosalmo piranha). Voracious fish. was a man and he had a cow and a donkey. One day he decided to find the source of all water. He killed his cow, dried the flesh and loading the donkey with the dried meat went in
search of the source of water. After a while he arrived at a swampy place where he and his donkey sank into the mud and died. The man was changed into a palometa fish.
